title: Watercolor "Seven Saturdays" 24 Pine Needle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Private heated pool and sitting spa **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day** The pool and spa are heated together- High-Speed Wireless Internet- Outdoor fireplace - 4 dedicated parking spots with additional parking throughout the community. - 6 adult bikes provided - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: "Welcome to "Seven Saturdays," a beautiful, brand new, professionally decorated Romair Construction home in the WaterColor Forest District. Enter this home and take in the breathtaking open concept great room, offering 12' ceilings, abundant windows, a stunning state-of-the-art kitchen, and lovely dining area. French doors will lead you to the pool and spectacular outdoor living area that features a spa and cabana. Also outside, the wrap-around porch boasts extra dining space, perfect for entertaining. Head to the second floor, which features one king primary suite, along with 2 additional king suites with private en-suites, making this home perfect for multiple families! The third floor features a second living space, a fitting retreat for kids or families. There is a fourth king suite, as well as a spacious room with sleeping for 6.For the ultimate privacy, retreat to the carriage house, which features a king bed, twin daybed, kitchenette, and full bathroom.You'll love every beautiful detail of the brand new beach haven! Book Today!
